prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Sync Companion", "Your existing pet profiles and items will automatically restore.", "Cloud Save Active"]
1: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Select options to watch your pet react live."]
2: ["Upload Pet Photo for Custom Generation", "Use bright lighting and clear forward-facing photos for best results.", "Clear face visible"]
3: ["Choose your path to pick your companion first."]
4: ["Your pet will launch directly onto your desktop. Check system tray if minimized."]
5: ["Rendering Desktop Pet Assets...", "Initializing 3D desktop engine..."]
6: ["Quick Desktop Controls", "Drag pet to move | Right click to hide or call"]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready + Free Starter Kit Unlocked!", "Free Starter Accessory Claimed"]
8: ["Certificate name automatically saved to desktop pet tag.", "Official Pet Tag Registered"]
9: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Pick Quick Start for preset companion pets or Custom Creator to generate a pet from photos.", "You can add more pets anytime after setup."]
